title: The internet’s favorite cat comes to Apple Arcade with Pusheen’s Place
title_zh: 互联网最受欢迎的猫来到Apple Arcade，Pusheen的场所

paragraphs.en: Pusheen’s Place, launching exclusively on Apple Arcade on October 1, is the first officially licensed game starring Pusheen the Cat. On October 1, Apple Arcade is rolling out a lineup of fun new games for players of every style, from cozy cat collecting to zombie-blasting mayhem to beloved App Store hits. Whether players want to unwind in Pusheen’s Place , dive into the adrenaline-pumping chaos of River City Survivors , or revisit App Store favorites like Terraria+ , Touchgrind BMX 2+ , and 4 Pics 1 Word+ , there’s plenty to discover, download, and play. Pusheen’s Place is the first officially licensed game starring Pusheen the Cat, the global icon of cuteness and whimsy. Available exclusively on Apple Arcade, the game lets players build a cozy Pusheen paradise and collect more than 100 adorable kitties. They can play, craft, and decorate dreamy rooms for popular characters like Pusheenicorn and Pancake Pusheen. Then, for an extra dose of fun, unwind with sweet mini-games like Snack Stack, Parfait Pop, and Batch Match. This game adds to Arcade’s thriving catalog of cozy games, joining fan favorites like Hello Kitty Island Adventure , Tamagotchi Adventure Kingdom , and Cozy Caravan . Cat lovers and cozy gamers say hello to their purr-fect new hangout in Pusheen’s Place, developed by Lively. From the long-running River City series comes River City Survivors, an explosive survivors-like action game that throws players into wave after wave of zombie chaos. Blast through hordes, unleash flashy special moves, and grab randomized upgrades to build an unstoppable run every time. Players can choose from more than 20 playable characters, including franchise icons Kunio and Riki, and recruit up to two companions to build their dream team. Blast through hordes and fight for survival in River City Survivors, developed by Arc System Works. And the hits keep coming, with three beloved App Store favorites also joining the service on October 1, completely free of ads and in-app purchases. Terraria+ is a sandbox action-adventure where players fight, explore, and build their way through an ever-expanding world. This version includes the Bigger & Boulder update 1.4.5, which brings a Dead Cells crossover, iconic Pals from Palworld, and much more to discover. Players can also join forces with up to seven friends via Game Center or local Wi-Fi and explore more than 20 biomes in a boundless adventure of survival, discovery, and creativity. Terraria+ developed by 505 Games.
paragraphs.zh: 《Pusheen’s Place》将于 10 月 1 日在 Apple Arcade 独家上线，这是以猫咪 Pusheen 为主角的首款官方授权游戏。 10 月 1 日，Apple Arcade 将推出一系列有趣的新游戏，适合各种风格的玩家，从温馨的猫咪收集到丧尸大混战，再到广受欢迎的 App Store 热门作品。 无论玩家是想在《Pusheen’s Place》中放松身心，体验《River City Survivors》的刺激混乱，还是重温《Terraria+》《Touchgrind BMX 2+》和《4 Pics 1 Word+》等 App Store 经典之作，这里都有丰富的内容等待探索、下载和畅玩。 《Pusheen’s Place》是以全球萌系与奇想代表人物——猫咪 Pusheen 为主角的首款官方授权游戏。 这款游戏仅在 Apple Arcade 上提供，玩家可以在其中建造一个温馨的 Pusheen 天堂，并收集超过 100 只可爱的猫咪。 玩家可以与 Pusheenicorn 和 Pancake Pusheen 等热门角色互动、创造并装饰梦幻的房间。 接着，还可以通过《Snack Stack》《Parfait Pop》和《Batch Match》等有趣的迷你游戏，享受更多欢乐与放松。 这款游戏进一步丰富了 Arcade 中日益壮大的温馨游戏阵容，与《Hello Kitty Island Adventure》《Tamagotchi Adventure Kingdom》和《Cozy Caravan》等粉丝经典作品一同登场。 猫咪爱好者和温馨游戏玩家，快来《Pusheen’s Place》这个完美（purr-fect）的新聚集地吧！该游戏由 Lively 开发。 来自久负盛名的《River City》系列的《River City Survivors》，是一款充满爆炸力的生存动作游戏，将玩家投入一波接一波的丧尸混乱之中。 突破成群的敌人，释放炫酷的特殊技能，并获取随机升级道具，让每一次战斗都势不可挡。 玩家可以从超过 20 名可操作角色中选择，包括系列标志人物 Kunio 和 Riki，还可以招募最多两名伙伴，组建自己的梦想团队。 在《River City Survivors》中突破敌群、为生存而战吧！该游戏由 Arc System Works 开发。 精彩内容仍在继续：10 月 1 日，三款广受欢迎的 App Store 经典游戏也将加入该服务，完全无广告且无应用内购买。 《Terraria+》是一款沙盒动作冒险游戏，玩家可以在其中战斗、探索，并在不断扩展的世界中建造自己的道路。 此版本包含“Bigger & Boulder”1.4.5 更新，带来了与《Dead Cells》的联动内容、来自《Palworld》的标志性伙伴以及更多值得探索的元素。 玩家还可以通过 Game Center 或本地 Wi-Fi 与最多七名好友组队，在无边无际的生存、探索与创造冒险中探索超过 20 种不同的生物群落。 《Terraria+》由 505 Games 开发。

paragraphs.en: And the hits keep coming, with three beloved App Store favorites also joining the service on October 1, completely free of ads and in-app purchases. Terraria+ is a sandbox action-adventure where players fight, explore, and build their way through an ever-expanding world. This version includes the Bigger & Boulder update 1.4.5, which brings a Dead Cells crossover, iconic Pals from Palworld, and much more to discover. Players can also join forces with up to seven friends via Game Center or local Wi-Fi and explore more than 20 biomes in a boundless adventure of survival, discovery, and creativity.
paragraphs.zh: 好消息不断，三款备受喜爱的 App Store 热门应用也将于 10 月 1 日加入该服务，完全无广告、无应用内购买。 Terraria+ 是一款沙盒动作冒险游戏，玩家可以在其中战斗、探索，并通过建造穿越一个不断扩展的世界。 此版本包含“更大与巨石”1.4.5 更新，带来了《Dead Cells》的联动内容、来自《Palworld》的标志性伙伴以及更多值得探索的内容。 玩家还可以通过 Game Center 或本地 Wi-Fi 与最多七位朋友联手，在无边无际的生存、探索与创造冒险中探索超过 20 种生物群落。

paragraphs.en: Rounding out the trio are Touchgrind BMX 2+, a physics-driven BMX stunt game with unique two-finger controls that make every trick feel real, and 4 Pics 1 Word+, the Arcade edition of the popular puzzle game that’s stumped and delighted more than 400 million players worldwide.
paragraphs.zh: 完成这个三人组合的，还有《Touchgrind BMX 2+》——一款基于物理引擎的 BMX 特技游戏，其独特的双指操控让每一个技巧都显得真实生动；以及《4 Pics 1 Word+》，这款热门益智游戏的街机版曾让全球超过 4 亿玩家既困惑又欣喜。
